product_updates.content: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

product_updates.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
product_updates.content: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

product_updates.title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
product_updates.content: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.

product_updates.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
product_updates.content: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.
